descriptions.preferred: The new spring growth of 'Dissectum Nigrum' is its distinguishing characteristic. The new shoots and foliage are noticeably covered with fine silvery hairs which make the unfolding new growth look almost gray. It soon loses the pubescence and attains the rich, deep red color so typical of this cultivar. Unfortunately, there are many Each leaf has seven finely dissected lobes as long as 12 cm, and each lobe is deeply dissected from the edges to the midrib. The lobes tend to hang down, making the leaf about 10 cm wide in many cases, and giving the whole plant a feathery, cascading appearance so desirable in the Dissectum Group. rhs.description: A small to medium-sized shrub with a dense, spreading habit that reaches a height of around 2. 5m. The deeply-cut leaves emerge in spring covered with a silvery down and coloured a deep bronze to burgundy red, maturing to an olive green and bronze colour in summer before turning red in autumn. Small red flowers in spring are followed by winged fruits in autumn

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture, drying winds or late spring frost. See Japanese maple cultivation
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt and a canker

care.cultivation: 宜栽培于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应补充浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤缺水、干燥风或晚春霜冻都可能导致叶片焦枯。参见 Japanese maple cultivation。

rhs_zh.description: 一种小型至中型灌木，株型紧密而开展，高度约 2. 5 米。 深裂叶在春季萌发时覆有银色绒毛，叶色为深青铜色至酒红色；夏季成熟后转为橄榄绿色与铜色，秋季再转红。 春季开小型红花，秋季结翅果。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 'Dissectum Nigrum' 的显著特征在于其春季新梢。 新枝与新叶表面明显覆盖着细密的银色茸毛，使展开中的新生长几乎呈灰色。 随后这些毛被很快脱落，叶色转为该品种典型的浓郁深红色。 每片叶通常有 7 个精细裂片，裂片长可达 12 厘米，并且每个裂片又从边缘深裂至中脉。 裂片常自然下垂，因此叶片宽度常约 10 厘米，使整株呈现 Dissectum Group 所珍视的羽毛状、瀑布式姿态。 正如其名称所示，这一槭树在夏季中期之前能比许多其他红叶细裂品种更持久地保持深红色，但通常不如 'Crimson Queen' 保持鲜红色的时间那么长。 全日照或半阴栽植都会影响保色时间，其中半阴环境更有利于延长深色表现。 至夏末，叶色逐渐转为铜色或铜绿色；秋季则显现浓艳明亮的红色。 'Dissectum Nigrum' 是生长旺健的细裂型品种，具典型的下垂生长习性。 大型老株高可达 4-5 米，冠幅至少相当。 该品种曾是苗圃贸易中较优秀的红叶细裂品种之一，但后来大概被
